# GWAS results, averaged expression ( averaged BLUPs)

In this report you can find all GWAS results obtained for averaged TE expression (BLUPs) based on the different subsets (all TEs, restricted to the specific pathway/cluster/family, etc).

Before averaging BLUPs were performed data transformed by: z scale (expression-mean(expression)/sd(expression) and log2 transformation

```{r}
library(data.table)
library(qqman)
# Read SNPs of interest 
significant_genes <- read.csv2("/groups/nordborg/projects/ddm1_resilencing/10_metadata/a_priori.genes_with_coordinates.txt", header=T)
gene_coordinates <- read.table("/groups/nordborg/projects/ddm1_resilencing/10_metadata/tair10_baseline_genes_with_coordinates.csv")
gene_coordinates$V1 <- as.numeric(gene_coordinates$V1)
genes_and_tes <- read.table("/groups/nordborg/projects/ddm1_resilencing/11_resources/ref_genome/genes_and_tes.txt")

plot_gemma_gwas <- function(file_path, N = 230, ylim_max = 10, maf_threshold = 0.05,
                            snp_table = NULL) {
  gemma_res <- fread(file_path, header = TRUE)
  gemma_res$r_squared <- 2 * gemma_res$af * (1 - gemma_res$af) * gemma_res$beta^2
  gemma_res$pve <- (2 * gemma_res$beta^2 * gemma_res$af * (1 - gemma_res$af)) / 
                   (2 * gemma_res$beta^2 * gemma_res$af * (1 - gemma_res$af) + 
                gemma_res$se^2 * 2 * N * gemma_res$af * (1 - gemma_res$af))
  # Create unique SNP ID 
  gemma_res$rs <- paste0("rs", gemma_res$ps, "_", gemma_res$chr)
  bonferroni_threshold <- maf_threshold / nrow(gemma_res)
  # Get SNPs to highlight 
  snps_to_highlight <- NULL
  if (!is.null(snp_table)) {
    hits <- do.call(rbind, lapply(1:nrow(snp_table), function(i) {
      gemma_res[gemma_res$chr == as.integer(snp_table$chrom[i]) &   # match types!
                gemma_res$ps > snp_table$start[i] & 
                gemma_res$ps < snp_table$stop[i], ]
    }))
    snps_to_highlight <- hits$rs
  }
  par(mar = c(5, 5, 2, 2))
  qq(gemma_res$p_wald, cex.axis = 2, cex.lab = 2) # qqplot
  # Manhattan plot
  par(mar = c(5, 5, 4, 2))
  manhattan(gemma_res, 
            chr = "chr", bp = "ps", snp = "rs", p = "p_wald",
            col = c("#1A1A1A", "#838B8B"), 
            genomewideline = FALSE, suggestiveline = FALSE,
            highlight = snps_to_highlight,
            ylim = c(0, ylim_max), 
            cex.axis = 2, cex.lab = 1.8,
            xlab = "Chromosome", 
            ylab = expression(-log[10](P)))
  abline(h = 7.5, col = "red", lty = 2)
  abline(h = -log10(bonferroni_threshold), col = "black", lty = 2)
  
  invisible(gemma_res)
}
```

```{r}
  library(data.table)
  library(ggplot2)
## Function to do an enrichment plot 
enrichment_plot <- function(gwas_data, 
                            gene_coordinates, 
                            significant_genes,
                            enrichment_window = 15000,
                            maf_filter = 0.05,
                            min_apriori_count = 1,
                            enrich_color = "#210F37",
                            fdr_color = "#F2613F",
                            title = "Enrichment Plot"){

  # Filter MAF
  # Read file if input is a path
  if(is.character(gwas_data) && file.exists(gwas_data)){
    cat("Reading file...\n")
    gwas_data <- read.delim(gwas_data, sep = "\t")
  }
  gwas_dt <- as.data.table(gwas_data)[af > maf_filter]
  gene_dt  <- as.data.table(gene_coordinates)
  # Compute windows
  gene_dt[, start_window := V4 - enrichment_window]
  gene_dt[, end_window   := V5 + enrichment_window]
  # Assign each gene its max -log10(p_wald) within window
  setkey(gwas_dt, chr, ps)
  gene_pvals <- gwas_dt[gene_dt,
                        .(gene_id  = i.V10,
                          min_pval = max(-log10(p_wald), na.rm = TRUE)),
                        by = .EACHI,
                        on = .(chr = V1,
                               ps >= start_window,
                               ps <= end_window)]
  
  # Clean up
  gene_pvals[is.infinite(min_pval), min_pval := NA]
  gene_pvals <- gene_pvals[!is.na(min_pval)]
  # Label apriori vs background
  gene_pvals[, apriori := gene_id %in% significant_genes$tair_id]
  n_apriori    <- sum(gene_pvals$apriori == TRUE)
  n_background <- sum(gene_pvals$apriori == FALSE)
  # assign thereshold
  thresholds <- seq(0, max(gene_pvals$min_pval, na.rm = TRUE), by = 0.1)
  results <- data.frame(threshold = thresholds, xp = NA, yp = NA)
  # Compute ratios
  for(p in thresholds){
    results$xp[results$threshold == p] <- sum(gene_pvals$min_pval[gene_pvals$apriori == TRUE]  >= p) / n_apriori
    results$yp[results$threshold == p] <- sum(gene_pvals$min_pval[gene_pvals$apriori == FALSE] >= p) / n_background
  }
  
  results$enrichment <- results$xp / results$yp
  results$FDR        <- results$yp / results$xp
  # numerical instability
  #results$enrichment[results$xp * n_apriori < min_apriori_count] <- NA
  #results$FDR[results$xp * n_apriori < min_apriori_count] <- NA
  #results$FDR[is.infinite(results$FDR)] <- NA
  #results <- na.omit(results)
  scale_factor <- max(results$enrichment)
  # Plot
  p_enrich <- ggplot(results, aes(x = threshold)) +
    geom_line(aes(y = enrichment), color = enrich_color, size = 1) +
    geom_point(aes(y = enrichment), color = enrich_color, size = 2) +
    geom_line(aes(y = FDR * scale_factor), color = fdr_color, size = 1) +
    geom_point(aes(y = FDR * scale_factor), color = fdr_color, size = 2) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 1, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray50") +
    scale_y_continuous(
      name = "Enrichment",
      sec.axis = sec_axis(~ . / scale_factor, name = "FDR")
    ) +
    xlab(expression(-log[10](p-value))) +
    ggtitle(title) +
    theme_classic(base_size = 16)
  print(p_enrich)
  # Top driving genes
  #cat("\nTop 10 a priori genes driving association:\n")
  #print(gene_pvals[apriori == TRUE][order(-min_pval)][1:10])
  invisible(results)
}
```

```{r}
## Function to make html manhattan plots 
make_manhattan <- function(input, threshold = 2, title = "Manhattan Plot", 
                           output_file = "manhattan.html", gene_coords = NULL){
  
  if(is.character(input) && file.exists(input)){
    cat("Reading file...\n")
    gwas_data <- read.delim(input, sep = "\t")
  } else {
    gwas_data <- input
  }
  n_snps <- nrow(gwas_data)
  bonferroni <- -log10(0.05 / n_snps)
  gwas_filtered <- gwas_data[-log10(gwas_data$p_wald) > threshold, ]
  if(!is.null(gene_coords)){
    cat("Annotating genes...\n")
    gwas_dt2 <- as.data.table(gwas_filtered)
    gene_dt2 <- as.data.table(gene_coords)
    # Join SNPs to genes using exact gene boundaries. Show ID only if the gene falls into 
    annotated <- gene_dt2[gwas_dt2, 
                          .(chr = i.chr, ps = i.ps, p_wald = i.p_wald, 
                            af = i.af, tair_id = V10),
                          on = .(V1 = chr, V4 <= ps, V5 >= ps),
                          mult = "first"]
    annotated[is.na(tair_id), tair_id := "."]
    gwas_filtered <- as.data.frame(annotated)
  }
  mh <- manhattanly(
    gwas_filtered,
    chr = "chr",
    bp = "ps",
    p = "p_wald",
    snp = "ps",
    annotation1 = "af",
    annotation2 = if(!is.null(gene_coords)) "tair_id" else NULL,
    suggestiveline = FALSE,
    genomewideline = bonferroni,# Bonferroni line
    title = title
    )
  htmlwidgets::saveWidget(mh, file = output_file)
  cat(paste("\nSaved to", output_file))
  mh <- mh %>% plotly::layout(yaxis = list(range = c(2, 10)))
  return(mh)
}
```

### KW test log2

```{r}
library(data.table)
kw_test <- fread("/groups/nordborg/projects/ddm1_resilencing/03_processing/006_gwas/all_plates_96w/kruskal_wallis_gwas/blup_overall_ddm1_average/log2/average_ddm1_log2_kw.tsv")
# Rename column to match what the function expects
kw_test$p_wald <- kw_test$p_lrt
# Optional: add af column if not present (needed for annotation1)
kw_test$af <- NA
kw_test$chr <- gsub("Chr", "",kw_test$chr)
kw_test$chr <- as.numeric(kw_test$chr)
# Plot
make_manhattan(kw_test, output_file  = "/groups/nordborg/projects/ddm1_resilencing/03_processing/006_gwas/all_plates_96w/kruskal_wallis_gwas/blup_overall_ddm1_average/log2/average_ddm1_log2_kw.html",gene_coords = genes_and_tes)


```

assoc_files <- list.files(assoc_folder, pattern = "\\.ddm1_blups_maf005.assoc\\.txt$", full.names = TRUE)

  cat("Plotting:", basename(f), "\n")

  })
}))

## Line L1 Superfamily, log2 transformed, with kinship

```{r, warning=FALSE,message=FALSE}
significant_genes <- read.csv2("/groups/nordborg/projects/ddm1_resilencing/10_metadata/a_priori.genes_with_coordinates.txt", header=T)
transposons <- read.csv2("/groups/nordborg/projects/ddm1_resilencing/11_resources/ref_genome/TAIR10_Transposable_Elements.txt", header=T, sep="\t")
transposons$chrom <- gsub("TE.*", "",transposons$Transposon_Name )
transposons$chrom <- gsub("AT", "",transposons$chrom )
transposons$gene_id <- transposons$Transposon_Name
transposons_line <- transposons[transposons$Transposon_Super_Family=="LINE/L1",] %>% select(gene_id,Transposon_Name, chrom,Transposon_min_Start,Transposon_max_End)
colnames(transposons_line) <- c("gene_id", "tair_id", "chrom", "start", "stop")
significant_genes_with_tes <- rbind(significant_genes,transposons_line) 

genes_and_tes <- read.table("/groups/nordborg/projects/ddm1_resilencing/11_resources/ref_genome/genes_and_tes.txt")

plot_gemma_gwas("/groups/nordborg/projects/ddm1_resilencing/03_processing/006_gwas/all_plates_96w/gemma_gwas/blup_gwas/blups_ddm1_superfamily_average/log2/with_K/LINE_L1.average_ddm1_log2_maf005.assoc.txt",N = 230, snp_table = significant_genes_with_tes)

enrichment_plot("/groups/nordborg/projects/ddm1_resilencing/03_processing/006_gwas/all_plates_96w/gemma_gwas/blup_gwas/blups_ddm1_superfamily_average/log2/with_K/LINE_L1.average_ddm1_log2_maf005.assoc.txt", 
                genes_and_tes, 
                significant_genes_with_tes)

enrichment_plot("/groups/nordborg/projects/ddm1_resilencing/03_processing/006_gwas/all_plates_96w/gemma_gwas/blup_gwas/blups_ddm1_superfamily_average/log2/with_K/LINE_L1.average_ddm1_log2_maf005.assoc.txt", 
                gene_coordinates, 
                significant_genes)
# Interactive plot
make_manhattan("/groups/nordborg/projects/ddm1_resilencing/03_processing/006_gwas/all_plates_96w/gemma_gwas/blup_gwas/blups_ddm1_superfamily_average/log2/with_K/LINE_L1.average_ddm1_log2_maf005.assoc.txt", threshold = 2, title = "LINE_L1.average_ddm1_log2_maf005", output_file = "/groups/nordborg/projects/ddm1_resilencing/03_processing/006_gwas/all_plates_96w/gemma_gwas/blup_gwas/blups_ddm1_superfamily_average/log2/with_K/LINE_L1.average_ddm1_log2_maf005.assoc.html", gene_coords = genes_and_tes)

```
